resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code with HSE06 and spin-orbit coupling (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any plane-wave DFT code supporting HSE hybrid functional and spin-orbit coupling can be used.
Norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials suitable for HSE and SOC calculations of Cd, Pb, and S.
Open-source code for constructing maximally localized Wannier functions and tight-binding Hamiltonians.
